source.page_or_item: Executive Order 8270—Exemption of Edward M. Nevils From Compulsory Retirement for Age; October 16, 1939; APP node 362977; common-crawl capture 2025-01-23T18:13:55Z

clauses.text:
Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Edward M. Nevils, Production Manager, Government Printing Office, who, during the current month, will reach the retirement age prescribed for automatic separation from the service, applicable to him, be exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), 1 hereby exempt the said Edward M. Nevils from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending October 31, 1940.

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT

CLAUSES:EO:8270#whole.text:
Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Edward M. Nevils, Production Manager, Government Printing Office, who, during the current month, will reach the retirement age prescribed for automatic separation from the service, applicable to him, be exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), 1 hereby exempt the said Edward M. Nevils from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending October 31, 1940.

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT

ORIGINAL:EO:8270.text:
Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Edward M. Nevils, Production Manager, Government Printing Office, who, during the current month, will reach the retirement age prescribed for automatic separation from the service, applicable to him, be exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), 1 hereby exempt the said Edward M. Nevils from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending October 31, 1940.

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT

The White House,

October 16, 1939.
